parts.title: Goal
text: A chatbot that uses the Mistral API and answers questions based on information I provided.

parts.title: Mistral API
text: Running Mistral locally was far too slow, especially on a Raspberry Pi.
Once I found out there was a fast European LLM provider, I wanted to try it out and upgrade my chatbot.

parts.title: ChromaDB
text: The bot's knowledge is stored in ChromaDB, a vector database that turns text into embeddings. When the user sends a message, it is converted into a vector as well, and ChromaDB searches for similar entries.
Matches below a certain distance threshold are added to the prompt, so the model can generate an answer based on the provided information.

parts.title: Flask
text: Flask exposes the chatbot as an HTTP service.
